authority: OS root is an explicit trusted computing-base authority, as it already is for kernel/root-owned runtime integrity. A root-owned sealed enrollment object authenticates only that an OS-root principal created it. The separately SDK-approved exact existing issuer code/runtime/profile must bind the object to real measurements; UID0 or a certificate file alone is insufficient.
no_privilege_extension: Reuse only the already authorized root resource-envelope bootstrap under its unchanged profile. No new sudo rule, capability, ptrace exception, AppArmor change or long-lived privileged daemon. If exact issuance/measurement is impossible, stop and report BLOCKED.

qualification_probe_lifecycle.purpose: Avoid a circular requirement in which the own proof/benign output hashes would be required before creating those same outputs.
qualification_probe_lifecycle.before_product_enrollment: The exact frozen executor must run its own two actual interruptions and bounded benign with actual witness/issuer code, source/runtime/lock/filter/resource and physical-retirement coverage. These are non-authorizing control probes. The witness must be included in actual actor/cgroup/lease-retirement evidence.
qualification_probe_lifecycle.probe_is_not_product_authority: Before the own proof and benign reviews exist, any diagnostic enrollment/sample must use a distinct explicit probe-only format rejected by the public SDK consumer. No app/native ROS/VM product admission and no borrowed historical proof hashes. Test private keys remain ephemeral; no product enrollment or signing authority is emitted.
qualification_probe_lifecycle.source_and_topology: The exact phase-dependent probe/public paths and all actual actors/FDs must be source-pinned and reviewed before own qualification. Switching from probe to public may populate only the already declared dynamic same-subject proof/benign/admission binding fields; changing code/input/executor/mount restarts whole qualification.
qualification_probe_lifecycle.product_path: Only after those current same-subject outputs and independent retirement reviews exist may the existing root issuer create uwvm-os-root-witness-enrollment-v1 bound to both exact proof hashes. The numbered states below describe that product enrollment path.
qualification_probe_lifecycle.VM_owner_must_supply: Exact source for both prequalification probe and public state paths, their raw kernel/original evidence and closed input/argv/FD topology. This candidate has not implemented or run either producer path.
